figures.shows: The Content Browser in the folder Models/coin-gold after the import, left to right: the Textures folder, the selected model coin-gold.glb, expanded, then its mesh, material and texture to its right in the grid
figures.caption: The model's folder after the import. Left to right: the Textures folder, the model coin-gold (selected, with the collapse arrow), then its sub-assets to its right in the grid. They are the mesh, named coin-gold like the model, then the material and the texture, both named after the image file in Textures.
figures.alt: The Content Browser in Assets, Models, coin-gold. A Textures folder comes first, then the selected model coin-gold with a gold coin thumbnail and a small arrow. Three tinted tiles follow in the same row: the mesh coin-gold with the same coin thumbnail, the material on a sphere, the texture as a grid of colored squares. Both are named after the image file, and the tile cuts the texture's name short.
